limitations: Measures change against the last accepted output, not correctness.
Requires a stored accepted snapshot; without one there is no reference value.
Reads structured JSON only: no extraction, no model calls, no OCR, no PDF/image/Excel input.
Text deltas use deterministic edit distance (rapidfuzz ratio), not semantic equivalence.
Arrays are compared by index; a reorder appears as several changed elements.
No database or object-store connectors, no scheduled re-runs, no drift monitoring, no rollback.
No ground-truth labelling tool and no statistical significance testing.
